{{Quote|Why, you stuck-up, half-witted, scruffy-looking nerf-herder!''"<br />"''Who's scruffy-looking?|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
'''Nerfs''' were a group of antlered, herbivorous [[Mammal/Legends|mammal]] [[Species/Legends|species]], found all across [[The galaxy/Legends|the Galaxy]].

==Biology==
[[File:Nerf.png|thumb|left|200px|A ''common Nerf'' living in the plains of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]]]
Nerfs were large ungulate quadrupeds, characterized by their four curved horns and shaggy coats of fur. The common nerf stood about 1.3 meters at the shoulder. Their mass of hair tangled easily, creating a perfect web for insects and foreign objects to cling to. Nerfs carried around a pungent odor, and were recognized as being some of the smelliest beasts in the Galaxy. Creatures often chewed their cud, creating excessive spittle that further added to their unpleasant image. The spit was sticky, black in color, and near-impossible to remove from clothing. Their saliva also had [[Acid/Legends|acidic]] qualities, and could cause burns if it landed on exposed skin.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" />

Male nerfs were generally larger and more aggressive than their female counterparts, with more pronounced horns. They were known to trample the young and batter the females. Because of this, during certain times, males were typically kept separated from the rest of the herd.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" />

In the wild, nerfs were common prey for predators such as [[Manka cat/Legends|manka cats]] and [[taopari]]s. They were often hunted by sentient beings such as the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]]. Nerfs had unusually keen night-vision, helping them to spot nocturnal predators with ease.

==History==
Nerfs originated on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and became a significant farm livestock because of their meat and fur. Exported from Alderaan to be raised on various other planets, nerfs were raised on ranches<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" /> and in [[Animal nursery|animal nurseries]],<ref name="battlegrounds">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> typically held within enclosed pens and pastures. Populations on the worlds of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] and the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] allowed multiple species of nerfs to survive the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. However they were rarely seen beyond the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], since most ranchers there chose to breed and raise the less-troublesome local species, such as [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]], which were much easier to handle.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" /> Some planets developed efficient nerf production and monitoring programs, such as the [[Fennesa Nerf Herding Council]].<ref name="wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030206nerf|series=Creature Feature|text=Mountain Nerf}}</ref> Attempts of raising nerfs on more exotic planets like [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] were made, but proved unsuccessful.<ref name="scruffy looking" />
[[File:Nerf-aa.jpg|thumb|right|190px|A nerf and [[Nerf herder/Legends|herder]].]]
Herders of the beasts—[[Nerf herder/Legends|nerf herders]]—were well known for being as ''scruffy-looking'' and surly as their livestock. They would take the females and young out in the field to graze for weeks at a time, while the males ate harvested grasses back on the ranch. Although nerf herders were looked upon as lesser beings, their role in society was vital, and their job was often generational.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" />

[[Nerf-hide/Legends|Nerf-hide]] and fur was highly used in various products. To mask nerfs' terrible odor, the fur had to be treated with strong chemicals before being carded into sheets of [[Nerf-wool/Legends|wool]] for use in clothing, foot-wear, and furniture.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species" />

===In cookery===
Nerf meat was among the most profitable in the galaxy, and [[Nerf steak/Legends|nerf steak]] restaurants were commonly found in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The nerf meat industry was a very important sector of the economy of planets such as [[Olanet]]. Some companies were dedicated to processing nerf meat, such as [[Haugg Nerf Industries]], [[Grand Horn Ranch Corporation]], and [[Davengatt's Double-Zed Nerf Ranch]].<ref name="Death">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20011018a|text=Death, Dirt, and the Nerf Rancher's Daughter|int=Death, Dirt, and the Nerf Rancher's Daughter}}</ref><ref name="SWBH">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>

Nerf meat was prepared and served in a variety of ways such as:
*[[Braised nerf]]<ref name="IR">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref>
*[[Nerfburger/Legends|Nerfburger]]<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>
*[[Nerfloaf]]<ref name="TNJOR">''[[The New Jedi Order: Recovery]]''</ref>
*[[Nerf medallion]]<ref name="TPS">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref>
*[[Nerf ribs]]<ref name="DNII">''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]''</ref>
*[[Nerf sausage]]
*[[Nerf steak/Legends|Nerf steak]]
*[[Nerf steak stew]]<ref name="Exile">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''</ref>
*[[Nerf tenderloin]]
*[[Smoked nerf]]<ref name="X-w:RS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>
*[[Nerf cubes/Legends|Nerf cubes]]<ref name="TPS" />
*[[Nerf strips]]
*[[Nerfspread]]<ref name="DNI">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

Nerfs produced [[Milk/Legends|milk]], which was drinkable by various sentients. Spiced [[Nerf-milk/Legends|nerf milk]] was a popular beverage around the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="spiced milk">{{TORcite|type=other|Spiced Nerf Milk}}</ref>

==Subspecies==
Because of the nerf's ability to easily adapt to harsh environments, and their wide distribution across the Galaxy, numerous defined sub-species and breeds existed. [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] itself was home to several species of nerf; including the [[Common nerf|Plains nerf]], also known as the ''common nerf'', the leaner [[Forest nerf]]<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" /> and the [[Hill nerf]].<ref name="scruffy looking" />

Other varieties included:
[[File:Nerf111.jpg|thumb|right|Grizmallt nerf]]
*The [[Grizmallt nerf]], a rare species only found on the planet [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]]. They bore a strong resemblance to [[Eopie/Legends|eopies]] with antlers.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" />
*The [[Mountain nerf]], evolved on [[Fennesa/Legends|Fennesa]] after being brought there by a group of colonists.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" />
*The [[Wildernerf]], a not domesticated, like its name suggests, species of nerf, found on a number of planets, including [[Noquivzor]].<ref name="X-w:RS" />
*The [[Larkin nerf]], originated on [[Pii III]].<ref name="Greel" />
*The [[Wooly-nerf]].<ref name="I, Jedi" />
*The [[Nightland nerf]], found on [[Voss]].<ref name="scruffy looking" />
*The [[Glacial nerf]], an all-white subspecies accustomed to cold climates.<ref name="Dantooine pets" />
*The [[Marsh nerf]], defined by its saturated orange fur.<ref name="Dantooine pets" />
*The [[Cavernous nerf]], a grey-furred golden-horned subspecies.<ref name="Dantooine pets" />
A number of nerf breeds were found on the [[Tunroth]] [[Triumvirate (planets)|Triumvirate]] worlds.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Nerfs in culture==
*[[Nerf-throwing]] was an illegal and unorthodox sport in which contestants would throw nerfs for distance and accuracy.<ref>[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Bounty Hunter'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>
*[[Nerf-pox]] was a mild [[Disease/Legends|infection]] common among [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Youngling/Legends|children]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
*[[A Nerf Herder's Guide to Nerfs]] was a book written during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="scruffy looking" />
